Return multiple values from a function.

Supplied answer
def calc(a, b):
    return a + b, a - b, a * b # returns a tuple
add, sub, mul = calc(10, 3)
print(add, sub, mul) # 13 7 30
Note: Python packs multiple return values into a tuple, which you can then unpack.
